obligations.statement: With the whitelist flag off, maybeApplyWhitelistGate returns the input slots unchanged with a null trace and never calls getChannelWhitelist.

With the flag on, maybeApplyWhitelistGate drops slots whose channel is not whitelisted and keeps the rest in order, so v1, v2, v3 with only v2's channel missing from the whitelist give ['v1', 'v3'] with trace reason 'applied'.
With the flag on and an empty whitelist, maybeApplyWhitelistGate keeps every slot and reports trace reason 'empty_whitelist_inclusive_fallback' with droppedCount 0.
With the flag on, maybeApplyWhitelistGate treats a slot with a null channelId as not whitelisted and drops it, so a whitelisted v1 and a null-channel v2 give ['v1'] with droppedCount 1.
